subject: research-grid + E5 prereg; tiny change in decisions.code_version
body: Pushed. autoresearch/grid.py turns results/prereg/<exp>.json into arm x seed (x settings) cells and runs each in its own process (python3 -m autoresearch.grid locally, or modal run modal_app.py --mode research-grid on Modal, which pins AUTORESEARCH_CODE_VERSION in the image). Prereg option keys are checked against the research parser, so typos fail. results/prereg/E5.json is a DRAFT (uniform vs halving vs market). @david-d: research/decisions.code_version() now returns AUTORESEARCH_CODE_VERSION when set (needed in Modal containers, which have no git); otherwise unchanged.
